record.question: Under which article can the Supreme Court issue a writ?
record.explanation: Answer A: Article 32. Article 32 empowers the Supreme Court to issue writs for enforcement of Fundamental Rights. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
